articles.title: Iran’s Secret Leader Says “I Disagreed” — But Peace Talks Go On
articles.summary: Iran’s top leader Mojtaba Khamenei said he didn’t want the deal with the U.S., but he let it happen anyway. Now both sides are in Switzerland to work out a 60-day peace plan.

articles.title: Ethiopia’s Nobel-Winning Leader Wins Big Again — But Not Everyone Is Cheering
articles.summary: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s party won over 90% of seats in Ethiopia’s election. He’s a Nobel Peace Prize winner, but some say he’s cracking down on critics and violence is growing in parts of the country.

articles.title: Trump Says Vandals Slashed the Reflecting Pool — Scientists Say It’s Just Algae
articles.summary: President Trump claims people cut a 250-foot gash in the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool and poured chemicals in. But scientists say the green water is just algae, and no arrests have been confirmed.
